subject: GPU cadence & capacity plan for HelixAI late-stage commitment
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-05 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GPU cadence & capacity plan for HelixAI late-stage commitment

Team —

HelixAI is signaling green to move forward pending our ability to guarantee a short standby of capacity while their procurement finishes (expected ~2 weeks). They want assurance they won’t be blocked by inventory when they sign. Key asks:
- 8x A100-equivalent GPUs sustained for 30 days on a dedicated pool, with the option to scale to 12x within 48 hours if usage spikes.
- A brief SLO on latency for 4k context models.

Can we do a quick inventory and recommend a safe contingency? Please include:
- exact node/sku mix that would satisfy the A100-equivalent ask
- whether we can offer a 14-day soft standby (no billing unless we hit the lock threshold) or need a paid hold
- any conflicts with other late-stage commitments for Sep 15–Oct 15 window

I’ve attached the draft SOW and the HelixAI capacity matrix they shared. I’ll loop in the customer once we have a recommended path.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_HelixAI_v2.pdf] [Attachment: capacity_spec_helixai.xlsx]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-05 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GPU cadence & capacity plan for HelixAI late-stage commitment

Jasmine —

Quick inventory check from infra ops and capacity planning:
- Available: 10 nodes that map to ~40 A100-equivalent GPUs (8 GPU nodes and 2 flexible 16-GPU nodes that can be partitioned).
- Reservations: 2 nodes already soft-held for another late-stage POC (Sep 12–Sep 28). Those can be negotiated but not yet released.

Recommended approach:
1) Offer a 14-day "soft-standby" window (no charges, non-exclusive). During that window we proactively mark the 8-GPU node bundle as preferred and prioritize HelixAI for any incoming repacks.
2) If HelixAI needs exclusivity, require a short paid hold (50% of monthly node rate pro-rated) to convert the soft-standby into a hard hold for up to 30 days. This preserves inventory and compensates capacity opportunity cost.

Risks/notes:
- If another committed Dedicated customer signs before the hard hold is taken, we may need to dispute priority with Sales Ops.
- Quick turnaround to convert from soft to hard hold is feasible within 6–12 hours if billing is approved.

I attached a quick capacity mapping and cost delta.

-Ben
Capacity Planner
[Attachment: capacity_mapping_20270905.xlsx]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-05 11:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GPU cadence & capacity plan for HelixAI late-stage commitment

Ben — thanks for the inventory snapshot. A few operational clarifications from pricing/ops perspective:
- For a 30-day hard hold at 8x A100-equivalent, estimated cost to customer (list) is $78,000/month; internal landed cost is ~45% of list. If we do a 50% pro-rated hold for 14 days, that’s a $39k invoice placeholder.
- Sales Ops can generate a temporary invoice/hold code (HOLD-HELX-4721) which triggers resource fencing in the orchestration layer. Once the PO/contract is executed we convert to a standard reservation.

Proposal for Jasmine to present to HelixAI:
- Offer 14-day soft-standby (no charge); upon signed PO convert to hard hold with a 50% pro-rated charge for the remainder of the 30-day window. If HelixAI wants immediate exclusivity, offer immediate hard hold at 50% with credit applied when the full monthly reservation is purchased.

If everyone agrees I’ll draft the invoice placeholder and loop in Finance to pre-approve the charge path.

-Aditya
Head of Dedicated Sales Operations

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@helixai.com>
Cc: HelixAI Procurement <procurement@helixai.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-05 14:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GPU cadence & capacity plan for HelixAI late-stage commitment

Alice —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per your request we ran an internal inventory check. Short version: we can support your target footprint and offer two paths:

Option A — 14-day soft-standby (recommended):
- We prioritize HelixAI for available nodes for 14 days with no charge. If another customer signs for the same nodes, we’ll escalate but will try to re-home you to a compatible node within the 48-hour scale window.

Option B — Hard hold / paid standby (if you need exclusivity):
- Immediate fencing of the 8-GPU pool for 30 days at 50% of the monthly rate pro-rated until a full reservation is signed. This converts to a reservation when the signed PO/contract is received.

Please see attached SOW v2 and the capacity mapping. Tell me which option you prefer and the target date you need the hold to start; we’ll issue a HOLD code and push the orchestration team to fence the nodes.

Next steps you could take now:
- Confirm preferred path (A or B) and requested start date
- If B, send procurement contact and we’ll surface the temporary invoice (HOLD-HELX-4721)

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_HelixAI_v2.pdf]

From: Alice Nguyen <alice@helixai.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: HelixAI Procurement <procurement@helixai.com>
Date: 2027-09-06 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GPU cadence & capacity plan for HelixAI late-stage commitment

Jasmine —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clarity. HelixAI will take Option B (hard hold) to lock capacity while procurement finishes approvals. Please issue the HOLD invoice and we’ll aim to return a signed PO within 5 business days. Our procurement lead is Marco Diaz (procurement@helixai.com).

One small ask: can you confirm the expected latency SLO for the 4k context baseline so our SREs can sign off? Otherwise the rest is green.

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Head of Product, HelixAI
